lyrics:
[Intro]
(Ocean waves)

[Verse 1]
Sun on my shoulders, ice in my glass
Letting the hours drift slowly past
Palm shadows moving across the blue
Nothing to chase, nothing to do

[Chorus]
Salt and sunlight
Melting into the afternoon
Salt and sunlight
No one's leaving too soon

[Instrumental Break]

[Verse 2]
Pink sky rising over the bay
The city hums a mile away
Your hand in mine, the music low
The tide decides how slow we go

[Chorus]
Salt and sunlight
Melting into the afternoon
Salt and sunlight
No one's leaving too soon

[Bridge]
(Whispered) Stay a little longer
Stay a little longer

[Outro]
Salt and sunlight...
(Waves fade)
